Un navigateur web aux couleurs d'ONIRIQU: A web browser in ONIRIQUE colours that leaves room for your DAW. Sites look just like in Chrome, but the tabs you're not looking at go to sleep.
Environ 20 % de mémoire en moins que Chr: About 20 % less memory than Chrome on the same sites
Onglets cachés en veille après 30 second: Hidden tabs sleep after 30 seconds and are freed after 10 minutes
Si « Windows a protégé votre ordinateur: If “Windows protected your PC” appears: More info, then Run anyway. The browser isn't signed yet, hence the warning.
Construit sur Chromium, le moteur libre: Built on Chromium, the open-source engine behind Chrome and Edge, through Microsoft Edge WebView2, already part of Windows.
VPN gratuit intégré pour les membres ONI: Free built-in VPN for ONIRIQUE members
Google et les sites en thème sombre, aux: Google and sites in dark mode, in ONIRIQUE colours
Installation en un clic, sans droits adm: One-click install, no administrator rights needed. Uninstall it from Windows Settings.
Raccourcis et dossiers sur l'accueil, hi: Shortcuts and folders on the home page, history, your choice of colours
Mode Studio : ton DAW ouvert, les onglet: Studio Mode: with your DAW open, hidden tabs leave it the whole machine
Bloqueur de pubs, barre latérale (CLOUD,: Ad blocker, sidebar (CLOUD, messages, Discord), mini player
Windows 10 ou 11, 64 bits · 49 Mo — macO: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit · 49 MB — macOS 13 or later · 2 MB
Sur Windows, construit sur Chromium, le: On Windows, built on Chromium, the open-source engine behind Chrome and Edge, through Microsoft Edge WebView2, already part of Windows. On Mac, built on WebKit, Safari's engine, already part of macOS.
Groupes d'onglets et écran divisé, deux: Tab groups and split view, two pages side by side
Sur Mac, à la première ouverture : clic: On Mac, the first time: right-click the app, then Open. The VPN needs macOS 14 Sonoma there; the sidebar, mini player, tab groups and split view are Windows-only for now.
Tu viens de Chrome, Edge, Brave ou Opera: Coming from Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera: your bookmarks come over in one click, and your Google account too
